title: Part 3 — Conversation 8: an expenses query
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Đoạn này có một quy định kèm ngoại lệ; câu hỏi nhắm đúng vào ngoại lệ đó.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 53 through 55.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Hi, I'm querying an expense claim that was rejected. The taxi from the airport.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Let me check the reference… I see. Taxis aren't reimbursed when public transport is available on the route.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: My flight landed at half past midnight. There were no trains.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Ah — that's the exception, and it wasn't recorded. If you resubmit with the flight arrival time on the claim, it'll go through.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Do I need the boarding pass as well?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: The booking confirmation is enough, as long as it shows the arrival time. Resubmit by the fifth and it's in this month's run.

questions.prompt: 53. Why was the claim originally rejected?

options.text: It was submitted after the deadline.
No receipt was attached.
The amount exceeded the limit.
Taxi fares are not reimbursed where public transport runs.

questions.explanationVi: 'Taxis aren't reimbursed when public transport is available on the route'.

questions.prompt: 54. What makes this claim an exception?

options.text: The flight arrived when no trains were running.
The man travelled for a client meeting.
The taxi was booked by the company.
The man had approval in advance.

questions.explanationVi: 'My flight landed at half past midnight. There were no trains' — 'that's the exception'.

questions.prompt: 55. What must the man include when he resubmits?

options.text: His boarding pass
A manager's signature
Confirmation showing the arrival time
The taxi driver's details

questions.explanationVi: 'The booking confirmation is enough, as long as it shows the arrival time'. Thẻ lên máy bay được nói rõ là KHÔNG cần.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 9: choosing a caterer
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có hai lựa chọn kèm ưu nhược; câu hỏi hỏi lý do quyết định chứ không hỏi giá.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 56 through 58.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: We've got two quotes for the launch event. Fenwick is nine hundred, Marchetti is eleven fifty.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: For the same number of guests?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Both for eighty. But Marchetti includes staff to serve and clear; with Fenwick we'd be doing that ourselves.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That changes it. We'd need three people for the evening, and I'd rather they were talking to guests.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Agreed. Marchetti also did the summer event and there were no complaints.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then let's go with them. Can you confirm before Friday? They said the date isn't held after that.

questions.prompt: 56. What is included in the more expensive quote?

options.text: A larger number of guests
Venue hire
Staff to serve and clear
A discount for repeat customers

questions.explanationVi: 'Marchetti includes staff to serve and clear'. Số khách là như nhau (80) nên (A) sai.

questions.prompt: 57. Why does the man prefer that option?

options.text: It is cheaper overall.
Their own staff can talk to guests instead of serving.
The food is of higher quality.
It can be booked at short notice.

questions.explanationVi: 'We'd need three people for the evening, and I'd rather they were talking to guests'.

questions.prompt: 58. What must be done before Friday?

options.text: The booking must be confirmed.
The guest list must be finalised.
A deposit must be paid.
A second quote must be obtained.

questions.explanationVi: 'Can you confirm before Friday? They said the date isn't held after that'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 10: a software rollout
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Người nói dùng cách nói giảm nhẹ để bày tỏ nghi ngờ — câu hỏi hàm ý nhắm vào đó.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 59 through 61.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: The vendor says the whole rollout can be done in two weekends.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Two weekends. Well, they're certainly optimistic.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: You don't think it's realistic?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Not with sixty machines and no test environment. The last upgrade took a month and that was a smaller change.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: So what would you propose?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Do one department first — Accounts, they're the smallest — and see what breaks. If that goes cleanly in a weekend, the estimate might hold. If it doesn't, we've learned it cheaply.

questions.prompt: 59. What does the woman mean when she says, 'they're certainly optimistic'?

options.text: She agrees the schedule is achievable.
She is pleased with the vendor's attitude.
She wants a written guarantee.
She thinks the estimate is unrealistic.

questions.explanationVi: Cách nói mỉa. Ngay sau đó bà ấy giải thích rõ lý do: 60 máy, không có môi trường thử, lần nâng cấp trước mất một tháng.

questions.prompt: 60. What reason does she give for her doubt?

options.text: The vendor has failed before.
The budget has not been approved.
There are sixty machines and no test environment.
Staff have not been trained.

questions.explanationVi: 'Not with sixty machines and no test environment'.

options.text: Starting with the smallest department
Cancelling the rollout entirely
Hiring a different vendor
Extending the deadline to a month

questions.explanationVi: 'Do one department first — Accounts, they're the smallest — and see what breaks'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 11: with a table of options
format: TOEIC Listening — Part 3 · Conversation 11, kèm bảng trên đề (câu 62–64)
instructionsVi: Dạng 'Look at the graphic'. Người nói KHÔNG đọc ra đáp án, mà mô tả gián tiếp để bạn tự đối chiếu với bảng. Đọc bảng trước khi băng chạy.
promptEn:
Listen to the conversation and answer questions 62 through 64. Refer to the price list below where indicated.

MEETING ROOM HIRE — half day
Room A (8 seats) — £60
Room B (16 seats) — £95
Room C (24 seats) — £140
Room D (40 seats) — £210

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: How many are coming to the supplier briefing?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Twenty confirmed, and two more said they'd try.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: So we need something that takes at least twenty-two. The next size up from that is what I'd book.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Fine. Is that within budget? We were given a hundred and fifty.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Just about, with ten pounds to spare. Though that's for the room only — tea and coffee is extra.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Leave the refreshments then. We can put a kettle in the corner.

questions.prompt: 62. Look at the graphic. Which room will they book?

options.text: Room A
Room B
Room D
Room C

questions.explanationVi: Cần chỗ cho ít nhất 22 người. Room B chỉ 16, nên phải lên Room C (24 chỗ). Con số phòng không được đọc ra, phải tự đối chiếu bảng.

questions.prompt: 63. What is the budget for the room?
questions.explanationVi: 'We were given a hundred and fifty'. 140 là giá phòng, không phải ngân sách — bẫy đổi chỗ hai con số.

questions.prompt: 64. What do they decide about refreshments?

options.text: To order tea and coffee from the venue
To ask suppliers to bring their own
To skip them and bring a kettle
To request a larger budget

questions.explanationVi: 'Leave the refreshments then. We can put a kettle in the corner'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 12: a customer complaint call
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Chú ý phân biệt điều khách hàng ĐÒI với điều nhân viên thực sự có thẩm quyền làm.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 65 through 67.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I've been charged twice for the same subscription. Two payments of forty-nine pounds on the same day.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I can see both. That's a duplicate — I'm sorry. I'll refund one of them now.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: And I'd like some compensation for the inconvenience. I spent forty minutes on hold earlier.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I understand, and I've noted the wait time. I can't authorise compensation myself, but I'll pass it to my supervisor and someone will come back to you within two working days.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: How long will the refund take?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Three to five working days, depending on your bank. You'll get an email confirming it today.

options.text: She was charged twice for one subscription.
Her subscription was cancelled by mistake.
She was charged the wrong amount.
She did not receive a confirmation email.

questions.explanationVi: 'Two payments of forty-nine pounds on the same day' — trùng lặp, không phải sai số tiền.

questions.prompt: 66. What does the man say about compensation?

options.text: He will add it to the refund immediately.
It is not available in this case.
He must refer it to his supervisor.
She must write in to request it.

questions.explanationVi: 'I can't authorise compensation myself, but I'll pass it to my supervisor'. Ông ta không từ chối, chỉ nói không đủ thẩm quyền.

questions.prompt: 67. How long will the refund take?

options.text: Same day
Two working days
Up to a month
Three to five working days

questions.explanationVi: 'Three to five working days, depending on your bank'. Hai ngày làm việc là thời hạn phản hồi về BỒI THƯỜNG, không phải hoàn tiền.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 13: planning a staff survey
instructionsVi: Hội thoại cuối của Part 3. Ba người, có một điểm bất đồng được giải quyết ở lượt nói cuối.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation among three speakers and answer questions 68 through 70.

transcript.speaker: M1
transcript.text: For the staff survey — do we make it anonymous or not?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Anonymous. People won't be honest about their manager otherwise.

transcript.speaker: M2
transcript.text: I take that point, but then we can't follow up on anything specific. Last year someone reported a safety issue and we couldn't ask which site.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Fair. What if it's anonymous by default, with an optional box for people who are happy to be contacted?

transcript.speaker: M2
transcript.text: That works for me.

transcript.speaker: M1
transcript.text: Good. I'll draft it that way and circulate it Monday. Aim to send it out the first week of next month.

options.text: How many staff to survey
Whether the survey should be anonymous
Which company should run the survey
Whether to hold a survey at all

questions.explanationVi: 'do we make it anonymous or not?' là câu mở đầu và là chủ đề của cả đoạn.

questions.prompt: 69. What objection does the second man raise?

options.text: Specific issues cannot be followed up.
Anonymous surveys take longer to analyse.
Staff will not complete the survey.
The survey is too long.

questions.explanationVi: 'we can't follow up on anything specific', kèm ví dụ vụ an toàn năm ngoái không biết ở cơ sở nào.

options.text: The survey will not be anonymous.
Two separate surveys will be sent.
Anonymous by default, with an optional contact box.
Only managers will be surveyed.

questions.explanationVi: 'anonymous by default, with an optional box for people who are happy to be contacted'.
